# Turn a Paddle earnings export into a Xero or QuickBooks journal

> Free Paddle payout to journal converter: proves the orders add up to your payout, splits product sales income, shipping, tax you collected, Paddle fee and refunds by month, and downloads a balanced journal for Xero, QuickBooks Online or QuickBooks Desktop. Runs in your browser; nothing is uploaded.

Free and open source (MIT). Results are estimates from the numbers typed in, not legal, tax, financial or professional advice.
